meta.name: brief
meta.description: /cs:brief <topic> — Generate a one-page strategy brief from an office-hours intake. First step in the strategic sprint pipeline. Use when a strategic question needs to be framed before boardroom deliberation — e.g. locking options, assumptions, and success criteria for a pricing change or a market-entry decision.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成一页战略决策简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在高层讨论前把战略问题梳理清楚。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a strategic question into a one-page decision brief.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to frame a strategic question before a high-level decision meeting.

howto.what: 装上后,用 `/cs:brief` 加一个主题(或 office-hours 产出),Claude 会生成一页纸的策略简报并存入本地 briefs 文件夹。简报包含背景、问题、2-3 个选项、假设、约束、涉及角色、成功与终止标准。
howto.when: 当你要在董事会讨论前把战略问题框定下来时,如定价调整或市场进入决策,用 `/cs:brief` 加主题或 office-hours 产出即可触发。

say.text: /cs:brief 我们是否应该把定价上调 20%?
say.note: 生成一份含选项和成功标准的简报。
解析后生成更严谨的简报。

say.text: /cs:brief 为进入东南亚市场写一份战略简报
say.note: 自动补齐问题,保存简报。

howto.what_en: After installation, using `/cs:brief` with a topic (or office-hours output) makes Claude generate a one-page strategy brief saved under the local briefs folder. It includes context, question, 2-3 options, assumptions, constraints, affected roles, success and kill criteria.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to frame a strategic question before boardroom deliberation, e.g. pricing changes or market-entry decisions. Run `/cs:brief` with a topic or office-hours output.

say_en.text: /cs:brief Should we raise our price by 20%?
say_en.note: Generates a brief with options and success criteria.
Parses it for a more rigorous brief.

say_en.text: /cs:brief Write a strategy brief for entering Southeast Asia
say_en.note: Prompts for missing pieces and saves the brief.
